Honest note: a phone has no projector lens, so it cannot throw a picture onto a wall by itself. ShakeLight gives you the ways that really work:

• Project to computer: run ShakeLight Receiver on a computer that is connected to a projector or TV, and your phone shows on it over Wi-Fi.

• Cable: connect a USB-C to HDMI adapter straight to the projector. The picture plays there and your phone becomes the remote.

• DIY lens box: put the phone in a dark shoebox with a magnifying glass in the front, in a dark room. Turn on “Rotate 180°” so the picture lands upright on the wall.
